# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No additional code changes were required in this Apply Fixes pass. The prior amendments already delivered the habitat-aware, saturating root-zone oxygenation path, reused the computed `SubstrateOxygenationBreakdown` for tracing, and added the requested rootable-area clarification comment; the subsequent review approved the implementation with no blocking follow-up.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspect the approved review results and confirm whether any blocking follow-up fixes were requested for the root-zone oxygenation work.
2. [Skipped] Apply additional code changes for review follow-up items.
3. [Completed] Record the approved validation state for the substrate, root-zone oxygenation, denitrification, and lint coverage.

## Validation Evidence

- Review outcome was `approved` with no blocking amendments required.
- Approved review confirmed `cargo test -p tank_core` passed across all unit and integration test binaries.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --lib systems::substrate::tests -- --nocapture` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test root_zone_oxygenation -- --nocapture` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test denitrification -- --nocapture` passed.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core` produced zero warnings.

## Outstanding Risks

- Cross-crate workspace tests were not rerun in this stage; validation remains scoped to `tank_core`, which contains the touched implementation.
- The remaining review notes are non-blocking cleanup opportunities: initialization-time code still discards the returned breakdown, and `root_oxygenation_active_biomass_g()` still recomputes the habitat registry internally.
